en.summary: This mixed RTL commit contains a real DRL arithmetic bug-fix: FP8 and BF8 operands were decoded with the wrong exponent/mantissa layout, and the low-precision exception path did not correctly aggregate FP8/BF8 special cases.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly says FP8/BF8 handling was fixed.
The patch changes core DRL RTL that decodes formats, extracts mantissas, computes exponent bias, and raises exceptions.
The edited logic changes arithmetic correctness for low-precision tensor operations, not just debug or tests.
disqualifiers: The same commit also includes a separate max-exp optimization/fix path.
evidence: VX_tcu_pkg.sv swaps FP8/BF8 exp_bits and man_bits so FP8 becomes E4M3 and BF8 becomes E5M2.
VX_tcu_drl_shared_mul.sv changes FP8/BF8 mantissa extraction to match the corrected formats.
VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv updates FP8/BF8 exponent slices and bias constants to the corrected layouts.
VX_tcu_drl_exceptions.sv adds dedicated FP8/BF8 exception aggregation instead of only handling TF32/FP16/BF16.
VX_tcu_drl_mul_exp.sv starts passing FP8/BF8 classifiers and the full cls_c object into the exception logic.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: The bug is a low-precision floating-point format-decoding error in a tensor multiply-accumulate datapath. A design that treats FP8 and BF8 as the wrong exponent/mantissa layout will extract the wrong hidden bit and fraction, compute the wrong exponent bias, and mis-handle NaN/Inf propagation for those formats. The failure is triggered specifically when FP8/BF8 instructions or tensor lanes are active, especially on subnormal and special-value inputs.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: low-precision floating-point format decode and special-case handling
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: FP8 or BF8 operands enter the shared multiply / exponent / exception pipeline, especially with NaN, Inf, zero, or subnormal inputs
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a format-table mismatch so one 8-bit format uses the other format's exponent/mantissa partition, and optionally remove the dedicated FP8/BF8 special-case merge logic.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: swap format descriptor or restore stale exponent/mantissa slices
portability_notes: Map the bug to whichever block defines per-format exponent width, mantissa width, and hidden-bit rules.
If the DUT has separate decode and exception blocks, injecting either the wrong format table or the missing low-precision exception aggregation is sufficient.
This bug is reusable across tensor cores, fused MAC units, or any SIMD lane packer that multiplexes multiple FP formats through shared arithmetic.
concrete_injection_steps: In the per-format descriptor table, swap the FP8 and BF8 exponent-width and mantissa-width assignments.
In the mantissa unpack path, slice the 8-bit payload using the stale layout so the implicit leading bit and fraction bits are built incorrectly.
In the exception path, collapse FP8/BF8 back onto a path that ignores their per-subproduct NaN/Inf interactions.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL shared low-precision format decode, exponent-bias, and exception handling for FP8/BF8
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix corrects the FP8/BF8 format descriptors, then threads the corrected layout through mantissa extraction, exponent extraction/biasing, and exception aggregation.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the pre-fix FP8/BF8 exp_bits/man_bits entries in VX_tcu_pkg.sv and the older FP8/BF8 slices in VX_tcu_drl_shared_mul.sv and VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv; optionally drop the dedicated FP8/BF8 cases added in VX_tcu_drl_exceptions.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: FP8/BF8 tensor results become numerically wrong, and NaN/Inf behavior becomes inconsistent with the intended format semantics.
evidence_for_injection: The format table itself changed in VX_tcu_pkg.sv, which is the canonical source of exponent/mantissa widths.
The same commit updates downstream mantissa and exponent slicing, showing the bug propagated through multiple arithmetic stages.
Dedicated FP8/BF8 exception handling was added, which indicates the old path was incomplete for those formats.
notes: For a narrow reinjection, the format-table swap is the cleanest single edit.
The max-exp changes in the same commit are a different bug/fix family and should not be mixed into this injection unless intentionally broadening the fault.

zh.summary: 这个混合 RTL 提交中包含真实的 DRL 算术缺陷修复：FP8 和 BF8 被按错误的 exponent/mantissa 布局解码，而且低精度异常路径没有正确聚合 FP8/BF8 的特殊值情况。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写了修复 FP8/BF8 handling。
补丁修改了核心 DRL RTL 中的格式解码、尾数提取、指数偏置和异常产生逻辑。
这些改动直接影响低精度张量运算的算术正确性，而不是调试或测试层面的变更。
disqualifiers: 同一个提交里还包含了独立的 max-exp 优化/修复路径。
evidence: VX_tcu_pkg.sv 交换了 FP8/BF8 的 exp_bits 和 man_bits，使 FP8 变为 E4M3、BF8 变为 E5M2。
VX_tcu_drl_shared_mul.sv 按修正后的格式修改了 FP8/BF8 的尾数提取。
VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv 更新了 FP8/BF8 的指数切片和 bias 常量，使其匹配修正后的布局。
VX_tcu_drl_exceptions.sv 为 FP8/BF8 增加了专门的异常聚合，而不是只处理 TF32/FP16/BF16。
VX_tcu_drl_mul_exp.sv 开始把 FP8/BF8 classifier 以及完整的 cls_c 对象传入异常逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该缺陷属于张量乘加数据通路中的低精度浮点格式解码错误。如果设计把 FP8 和 BF8 当成错误的 exponent/mantissa 布局，就会提取错误的隐藏位和尾数、计算错误的指数偏置，并且在这些格式上错误处理 NaN/Inf 传播。缺陷会在 FP8/BF8 指令或张量 lane 激活时触发，尤其是在 subnormal 和特殊值输入下更明显。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 低精度浮点格式解码与特殊值处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: FP8 或 BF8 操作数进入共享乘法/指数/异常流水，尤其包含 NaN、Inf、zero 或 subnormal 时
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入格式表不匹配，让一种 8-bit 格式使用另一种格式的 exponent/mantissa 划分，并可选地移除专门的 FP8/BF8 特殊值合并逻辑。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 交换格式描述符或恢复过期的 exponent/mantissa 切片
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到定义各格式 exponent 宽度、mantissa 宽度和隐藏位规则的模块。
如果 DUT 把解码和异常处理分开，实现错误格式表或删除低精度专用异常聚合中的任一种都足以回注入缺陷。
该缺陷可复用于 tensor core、融合 MAC 单元，或任何通过共享算术路径复用多种 FP 格式的 SIMD lane 打包器。
concrete_injection_steps: 在每种格式的描述表中，交换 FP8 与 BF8 的 exponent 宽度和 mantissa 宽度配置。
在尾数解包路径中，按旧布局切 8-bit 数据，使隐含前导位和 fraction 位构造错误。
在异常路径中，把 FP8/BF8 退回到忽略其子乘积 NaN/Inf 交互的旧合并方式。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DRL 中 FP8/BF8 的共享低精度格式解码、指数偏置和异常处理逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复先纠正 FP8/BF8 的格式描述符，再把正确布局贯穿到尾数提取、指数提取/偏置和异常聚合中。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 VX_tcu_pkg.sv 中修复前的 FP8/BF8 exp_bits/man_bits 表项，并恢复 VX_tcu_drl_shared_mul.sv、VX_tcu_drl_exp_bias.sv 中旧的 FP8/BF8 切片；也可删除 VX_tcu_drl_exceptions.sv 中新增的 FP8/BF8 专用 case。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: FP8/BF8 张量结果会出现数值错误，NaN/Inf 行为也会偏离目标格式语义。
evidence_for_injection: 格式表本身在 VX_tcu_pkg.sv 中被修改，这里是 exponent/mantissa 宽度的权威来源。
同一提交还同步修改了下游尾数和指数切片，说明该缺陷会传播到多个算术阶段。
补丁新增了专门的 FP8/BF8 异常处理，说明旧路径对这些格式并不完整。
notes: 如果只想做窄范围回注入，最干净的单点编辑就是恢复格式表交换错误。
同一提交中的 max-exp 改动属于另一类缺陷/修复，不应和这里的注入混在一起，除非有意扩大故障范围。
